effect.diamond-pearl: This Pokémon's moves have 1.5× their power if their base power is 60 or less. This includes moves of variable power, such as Hidden Power and Magnitude, when their power is 60 or less. Struggle is unaffected. Helping Hand and Defense Curls boost to Rollout are not taken into account.
